slot_scores.name: unstated_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the objective or goal of the leasing plan. Its only question concerned whether profit values were totals or per-shop, and it then silently assumed the objective was to maximize total rent revenue.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total rent revenue, calculated as 20% of total annual profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or confirmed the optimization objective; it inferred it from the brief and stated it as the objective in READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slot H1 (objective) remained unresolved and was only silently assumed.

summary: The agent asked one useful clarification about profit interpretation but failed to ask about the core optimization objective, then stopped with a silent assumption that the goal was maximizing rent revenue.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
